name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins from Dev Digest: skills, agents and workflows for everyday engineering.

plugins.name: starter
plugins.description: Reference template plugin: one skill and one agent. Copy it to start a new plugin.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Engineering skills for TypeScript web projects: React, Next.js, Fastify, Drizzle and PostgreSQL, Zod, TypeScript, layered architecture, testing and security.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: A researcher agent for repository lookups and external research. It has no edit tools and reports findings with evidence.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: An architecture reviewer agent that checks a diff against layering and boundary rules, using the project's own rules and the engineering-paved-path skills.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: A Spec Driven Development workflow: spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer and plan-verifier agents, plus the implement and workflow-retro skills.
